notes: Inesun is an Amazon-only budget PTZ/IP camera brand with no official website hosting camera documentation. Searches for an Inesun RTSP/ONVIF/CGI guide, datasheet, or camera user manual returned nothing from the manufacturer. The only Inesun manual on ManualsLib is for a DVR (INS-24DVR02) and contains no RTSP path. Every RTSP path circulating for Inesun (/1/h264major, /h264major, /h264minor, /mpeg4cif, /cam1/mpeg4, MediaInput/mpeg4) originates solely from crowdsourced third-party aggregators (iSpyConnect, Camlytics), which state they have no affiliation with Inesun and that details are community-sourced and may be inaccurate. Product listings and a third-party review indicate the cameras are ONVIF/P2P and ship with the iVMS-4200 client (a Hikvision client, hinting at possible Hikvision OEM lineage), but no official Inesun document confirms any fixed RTSP URL, so per the CC0 no-guessing rule no template is published. To integrate, use ONVIF auto-discovery rather than a hand-built RTSP URL.
